name: @algomancy/ledgers
description: Every work queue on the client, in one place. open/ holds one file per open ticket (CT-n card and engine work, BL-n everything else), deleted when it closes; settled.jsonl is every settled report, ticket and verdict, append-only, last row per id wins. card-ledger.ts, claims.ts, unreached.ts and scenario-queue.ts are the derived queues over the pool. tickets.ts reads them; tickets.test.ts holds the locks; report.ts prints the open work and the next free ids. No dependencies of its own — it borrows the engine's tsc and @types/node.
